purpose: Cross-implementation timing replay with neutral same-function control and admission scope check
independent_challenge_method: Python random.Random(UTF8 string seed) with rejection of 91 prior training and 8 prior holdout input pairs; deterministic, not sealed from outside observers
statistic: median of 7 timeit repeats each at 30000 calls per function with alternating call order; 24 paired cases
neutral_control: same candidate function measured twice with alternating order on each case to quantify timing noise
comparison_limit: R1.2 baseline is not admitted by current Coder AST policy; never compare as production baseline
cpu_limit: 1 CPU in existing SHA-pinned python Docker image
